scoring_justification: Checker reimplements the TEREQUIL algorithm and the Elkins & Grove (1990) Gibbs energy equation of state to recompute the equilibrium composition pairs for the three temperatures and initial guess. The agent's reported mole fractions are compared to the recomputed reference within 0.001 mole fraction tolerance.

outputs.description: Computed equilibrium composition pairs for ternary feldspar at 700, 800, and 900 °C and 1 kbar.
